$comment: CURATED (hand-maintained). Every known disagreement between the canon (rtkd/iddqd master transcription) and a cross-check source, edit for edit. scripts/build_canon.py fails if the observed edits differ from this list in EITHER direction. Offsets: canon_offset/source_offset index the flat rune stream of the LP part; page/page_offset use that part's numbering (LP2-0-57 or LP1-0-16). Never 'fix' an entry by editing the canon -- adjudicate, then record.

divergences.summary: LP2 page 24, rune 172: canon AE (ᚫ), scream314 A (ᚪ).
divergences.adjudication: Unsolved page, so only the page image can decide it. Three lineages read AE; the canon keeps the majority reading. Queued for the Phase 4 P-8 template-matching re-read (not to be read by an LLM). Affects the unsolved stream at one position.

divergences.summary: LP2 page 57 (PARABLE), rune 80: canon Y (ᚣ) 'DIUINITY', scream314 E (ᛖ) 'DIUINITE'.
divergences.adjudication: Plaintext page. scream314's own English rendering of the same page reads 'Find the divinity within and emerge'; Dukotah CONFLICTS-B C-06 decides the same reading for canon.

divergences.summary: LP1 pages 6 and 7 (A KOAN): canon EA (ᛠ) twice, scream314 W S (ᚹᛋ).
divergences.adjudication: Solved page (Atbash then +3). Canon decodes to 'THAT IS NOT WHO YOU ARE' / 'THAT IS WHAT YOU DO NOT WHO YOU ARE', the koan's refrain and rtkd's published translation; scream314's reading gives 'WHAT'. Dukotah CONFLICTS-B C-02. Asserted by tests/test_solved_pages.py.

divergences.summary: LP1 page 10 (THE LOSS OF DIVINITY), rune 126: scream314 omits the O of 'FOLLOWNG'.
divergences.adjudication: Plaintext page; canon reads 'THE FOLLOWNG TWO ERRORS', scream314 'FLLOWNG'. A dropped rune in one transcription.

divergences.summary: LP1 page 10 (THE LOSS OF DIVINITY), runes 116-117: canon 'BELEIUE', cicada_tools 'BELIEUE' (the I moved one place).
divergences.adjudication: Plaintext page. Two lineages read the misspelling BELEIUE, and rtkd's English translation preserves it ('WE BELEIVE THE FOLLWING'); cicada_tools reads the dictionary spelling. Not image-adjudicated. The canon keeps the majority reading and solved_sections.json uses the canon runes as this section's plaintext.
